newsitem.title: UK: Rank buys British pub operator Tom Cobleigh.
newsitem.headline: Rank buys British pub operator Tom Cobleigh.

text.p: The Rank Organisation Plc branched out into pub ownership on Tuesday with an agreed bid for the Tom Cobleigh chain at 240 pence per share, valuing the company at around 95.6 million pounds ($149 million).
Rank said directors of Tom Cobleigh had given undertakings to sell shares representing 61.5 percent of the company.

In a statement, the diversified entertainments and leisure group said it intended both to develop Tom Cobleigh as a stand-alone business and to integrate some new Tom Cobleigh pubs into existing and future leisure locations.
Rank had been reported as a likely buyer of Tom Cobleigh. Its bid pipped an earlier offer from Yates Brothers Wine Lodges, according to the reports.
Tom Cobleigh had said on September 13 that it was in talks which might lead to an offer.
Rank said the deal was expected to have a neutral impact on earnings per share in the first full financial year of ownership and should enhance earnings after that. ($1=.6435 Pound)
